bio: Daughter of Edward McGuire and Mary Jane Gaffney; age 12 in the 1870 Danville household. Married Michael E. Riley (1850-1892) and was widowed young; children Celia (1882-1938), Edward A. (1884-1907), James Aloysius (1885-1939), Johanna Gertrude (1886-1957), Mary A. (1888-1950, m. Daniel F. Burns) and Eugene Francis (1890-1918). Lived in Plymouth 1880-1940. Sister of James McGuire (I282604494274), so John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt.
